title: A Multivariate Generalized Cox Model for Dependent and Simultaneous Default Times
abstract: arXiv:2508.05022v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a framework for dependent default times where each name defaults when an increasing driver crosses an independent unit exponential threshold. As in Gueye and Jeanblanc (2022), the drivers may jump, so defaults may occur at stopping times of the reference filtration, including predictable ones, and a common jump may cause no, one or several simultaneous defaults. For general drivers, we derive the conditional joint survival law by a backward recursion; it is an explicit product of survival functions if and only if, for every set of names, the predictable reduction of the compensator of their first default time is deterministic. If, moreover, defaults avoid predictable stopping times, the law is a fatal shock law with hazards identified from the drivers; predictable default atoms can rule this out. translated_title: 用于相关联和同时违约时间的多元广义Cox模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个相关违约时间的框架，其中每个主体（名称）在一个递增的驱动过程跨越独立的单位指数阈值时发生违约。正如Gueye和Jeanblanc（2022）所述，驱动过程可能发生跳跃，因此违约可能发生在参考滤流的停时处，包括可预测的停时，且一次共同的跳跃可能导致零个、一个或多个同时违约。对于一般的驱动过程，我们通过向后递推导出了条件联合生存律；当且仅当对于任意一组主体，其首次违约时间的补偿子的可预测约化为确定性时，该生存律才是生存函数的显式乘积形式。此外，如果违约可避免可预测停时，则该生存律是一个致命冲击律，其风险强度可由驱动过程确定；而可预测的违约原子可能排除这一性质。例子包括Lévy从属过程，以及具有随机约化但显式生存律的Liu模型和散粒噪声驱动过程。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个多元广义Cox模型框架，通过递增驱动过程跨越独立指数阈值来刻画相关联与同时发生的违约时间，并给出了条件联合生存律具有显式乘积形式的充要条件。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multivariate generalized Cox model for dependent and simultaneous default times driven by increasing processes crossing independent unit exponential thresholds, and characterizes necessary and sufficient conditions for the conditional joint survival law to admit an explicit product form.
